panels.title: Redis up
panels.description: 1 when the catalog service received PONG. 0 when Redis did not answer. Catalog and the gateway keep serving when this is 0.

panels.title: Exporter up
panels.description: 1 when Prometheus can scrape the Redis exporter.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used Redis memory. The local container caps this at 64 MB and evicts keys. Losing keys drops cache and rate-limit counters. It does not change stock or orders.

panels.title: Catalog cache
panels.description: Public catalog reads served from Redis, missed, or skipped because Redis failed. A miss still reads PostgreSQL. Checkout price does not use this cache.

panels.title: Command rate
panels.description: Redis commands per second reported by the exporter. This is server load, not cache hit ratio.
